payload.title: The procedure runner deploys through the release pipeline
payload.description:
The `papyrus-procedure-runner` stack is updated today by a hand-run change set, against the rule that nothing is created by hand. Add it to the release pipeline's stack list (`infra/pipeline/stacks.json`) with its allowed-changes entry, so a release builds the image, makes the change set, checks it and executes it, as it does for the monitoring stack. Any role change it needs follows the pipeline-roles approval path.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A release that changes the runner updates the stack with no hand step.
- A pull request touching it prints the dry run.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- (infrastructure; covered by the pipeline's own checks) pipeline dry run lists the runner stack; a Remove or Replace not on the allowed list stops the run.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** `infra/pipeline/stacks.json`, `infra/pipeline/allowed-changes.json`, `infra/procedures/papyrus-procedure-runner.yaml`. Pipeline-roles change needs approval after merge.

**Part of:** Infrastructure as code and the shared tier. Slice code I1 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
